title: Choose the visual world — The Agent Bazaar
question: The roll assigned The Gazette. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. (Code-led build — no image generation in this harness, so every card is judged on its written contract.)

options.label: The Gazette of Autonomous Spending
options.lineage: RBI / Government of India gazette notifications & circulars
options.thesis: Agent commerce rendered as the official record it aspires to be: every mandate a numbered notification, every gate a standing order, every capture sealed in the public gazette.
options.viewport: Full-bleed gazette front page: masthead THE AGENT BAZAAR — being the official record of autonomous spending, notification number and date; beneath it, live notifications print as numbered clauses (INTENT filed… CART committed… SEALED ₹749) while the street's agents appear as the public-notice board, and standing orders (your walls) sit as the gazette's rule column.
options.risk: Reads bureaucratic-quiet unless the live wire keeps it moving; the craft challenge is gazette dignity at ticker speed.

raised.raise: Every live element carries its printed marginal annotation — Fig.-numbered, pointer-lined — so explainability becomes typography.
The day's settlement totals render as fixed-place instrument digits, engraved caps beneath — the ₹ as a physical count.
Standing-order walls are one drag that re-typesets the enforcement clause live — control as typography.

options.label: The Settlement Sheet
options.lineage: NPCI clearing-house settlement sheets & continuous stationery
options.thesis: The page IS today's settlement statement: batch header at dawn, live entries appended as ruled rows all day, totals strip closing the batch.
options.viewport: A single unbroken sheet: batch header (settlement date, cycle no.), the live entry table filling as agents transact, marginal totals column ticking, the day closed by a stamped totals strip.
options.risk: The direction most payments-engineer submissions would land on — familiar and safe; also print-quiet like the gazette.

options.label: The Cutaway Street
options.thesis: Every stall loses its wall, every agent wears a printed label mid-task — explainability as a gouache cutaway world.
options.viewport: One continuous labeled street pans edge to edge; entering a stall swings its facade open while agents keep working, every object annotated.
options.risk: Childhood warmth undercuts fintech gravitas — judges may love it and still not take it seriously.
options.kept: Its labeled-cutaway discipline was donated to the Gazette as marginal annotations.

options.label: The Instrument Bench
options.thesis: Every metric a glowing tube bank; every count arrives as visible plasma.
options.viewport: Tube banks own the viewport — ₹ captured, gates held, scams blocked — digits cross-fading with mechanical depth.
options.risk: A component grammar, not a world: numbers glow, governance vanishes.
options.kept: Its fixed-place instrument digits were donated to the Gazette's settlement totals.

options.label: The Living Specimen
options.thesis: One giant glyph, one slider, the whole grid breathing with the axis.
options.viewport: A monumental ₹ under an axis slider — drag it and the enforcement text re-typesets across the page.
options.risk: Type-demo first, product second: auditors get beauty, not bearings.
options.kept: Its one-drag-morphs-the-system control was donated to the Gazette's standing orders.

options.label: The Ops Dashboard
options.thesis: Cards, charts, a sidebar, a neon accent — the category standard played completely straight.
options.viewport: Sidebar + KPI row + live feed table; competent, familiar, forgettable.

registers.plain: A fresh hand, same spread of worlds.
registers.safer: Remaining conventional candidates (bahi-khata cloth ledger, IRCTC reservation chart, UPI success-screen monumentalism) plus the canon.
registers.bolder: Foreign forms only, at full commitment (club-sleeve scrawl, cyclorama dawn, streetwear quote-grammar).
